TextureHandler.LoadTexture.desc: Binds the texture's display list; if the texture is not loaded yet it draws a placeholder and queues the object as a pending request.

params.arg2: Filename, or (when arg1 is a number) the filename.
params.arg3: Object to Invalidate once the load finishes.

TextureHandler.DeleteTexture.desc: Decrements the reference count; at zero it deletes the display list and frees the texture via gl.DeleteTexture.

TextureHandler.Update.desc: Loads the requested textures one by one within the per-frame timeLimit (about 13 ms), calling Invalidate on the requesting objects when done.

module.summary: Async texture loader: cache one display list per texture, draw a placeholder while loading, then load queued textures inside a per-frame time slice and invalidate.

fileDesc: Asynchronous texture loader: caches texture display lists, draws a placeholder and queues requests for missing ones, then loads them within a per-frame time slice and Invalidates the requesters.
